The original plan finished Go-live on Tue 12/15, so the 2-day slip in task 2 pushes the project finish out by one working day. The slip reaches the end through the UAT round 2 chain (tasks 2 → 3 → 4 → 10), which was the critical path.

FINAL ANSWER: Wed Dec 16
